whenToUse: Messages in chat or collaboration tools.
You want to tell a few feelings apart.
whenNotToUse: Only one of two answers is needed (use was this helpful).
There are so many emoji that choosing gets hard.

alternatives.name: Like Button
alternatives.reason: A single expression of agreement is enough.

accessibility: Chips are aria-pressed toggles whose names include the feeling and the count.
The emoji themselves are aria-hidden, so only the names are read.
The add button announces the picker's state with aria-expanded.
